ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the figure there is a parallelogram-like grid made of blue slanted lines, with intersections labeled F, G, E, H. Pink arrow marks show that the two groups of slanted lines are respectively parallel. ∠1 is labeled near point F, ∠3 is labeled near point E, and ∠2 is labeled near point G. Reasoning: According to the parallel-line relationships in the figure, ∠1 and ∠3 are in corresponding angle positions formed by the same transversal cutting two parallel lines, so m∠1 = m∠3. From the expressions given in the problem, 3x + 40 = 2x + 70, solving gives x = 30. Then m∠3 = 2x + 70 = 2(30) + 70 = 130. Then according to another set of corresponding angle/alternate interior angle relationships in the figure, ∠2 and ∠3 are congruent, so m∠2 = 130. The problem gives m∠2 = 2(y - 10), therefore 2(y - 10) = 130, y - 10 = 65, y = 75.
